text:
tony: Quick sync — we need a concrete approach for request/response logging that balances debuggability + cost + PII safety across hosted/dedicated/private. Draft constraints above. Any proposals?

maria: high-level idea: two-layer strategy — (A) route-level sampling (deterministic) to keep per-customer traces consistent, (B) content redaction pipeline before any hosted telemetry leaves infra. keep raw payloads only for Dedicated/private if opted in.

ton: @maria can you sketch how deterministic sampling works with rollouts? we need predictable samples for A/B and canaries.

maria: sure — use `sha256(customer_id || route || day) % N` to decide sample. N is per-route target rate. deterministic so multiple retries/rollouts show same set. doesn't leak PII because hashing happens server-side before export. :white_check_mark:

sasha: +1 on deterministic hashing. also add a per-org override flag in the console so SREs can temporarily increase sampling for incidents without changing global policy. UI should show last-change and who toggled.

kevin: concern: embeddings endpoints may leak sensitive substrings even after basic redaction. we should run a lightweight PII classifier before storing. if classifier flags, store only tokenized/hashed embedding and a small redacted snippet.

maria: agreed. propose pipeline order: 1) apply route policy (drop or forward), 2) run content-based redaction rules (PII regexes + ML classifier), 3) if flagged critical, redact and mark retention as short. non-flagged follow standard retention.

olivia: cost telemetry note — we should not sample purely randomly. prefer error-rate and latency-triggered upsampling. e.g., if a route error rate > 0.5% or p95 latency > SLO, temporarily bump sampling to 5% for 1h. this reduces noise but keeps good coverage for anomalies.

ton: can you show a simple policy sketch we can use in prod? small YAML would help for ops to review.

maria: here's a sketch:```yaml
routes:
  - name: /api/v1/generate
    base_sample: 0.002  # 0.2%
    deterministic_key: customer_id
    upsample_triggers:
      error_rate_pct: 0.5
      p95_ms: 1200
    max_sample: 0.05
redaction:
  level: "content-aware"
  regex_rules:
    - name: ssn
      pattern: "\\\b\\d{3}-\\d{2}-\\d{4}\\\b"
      action: redact
  ml_detector: "pii-v2"  # local model, no external calls
  preserve_hash: true
retention:
  hosted:
    default_days: 7
    flagged_days: 1
  dedicated:
    default_days: 30
    admin_raw_access: true
```

sasha: Nice. A couple of operational notes: (1) Keep redaction models in the private cluster for hosted so we never send raw text to third-party detectors. (2) Log meta that a redaction happened (`redaction.tags`) to help SREs triage without exposing content.

kevin: For compliance, some customers (enterprise) will want auditable raw logs. We should add an encryption-at-rest toggle and access logging when raw is enabled. That needs legal sign-off but doable for Dedicated/private.

olivia: rollout UX: in the console, allow org-level toggles with a clear banner: "Raw logs enabled — each access is audited" and a one-click rollback to redacted-only. Show cost estimate before enabling. :warning:

ton: good. how do we expose sampling telemetry in the Console? product wants per-route actual-sample-rate + estimated token cost.

maria: we can emit a small metrics set: `sampled.requests.count`, `sampled.token.estimated`, `sampling.rate.applied`. wire to existing per-route dashboards. keep metrics as aggregated counters only (no content).

audit-bot: NOTE: retention defaults updated in staging to 7d hosted, 30d dedicated for testing.

sasha: question on export: do we allow exporting redacted payloads to S3? some support flows need full redacted payload dumps. If yes, exports must run in customer region and abide by org policy.

kevin: yes allowed, but require an export policy approval flow (owner + security). store S3 path in audit log.

tony: action items: @maria draft final RFC with YAML + threat model; @sasha spec console toggle + audit logs; @olivia propose dashboard widgets and cost calc; @kevin draft encryption/access controls for raw retention. I'll schedule a 30m sync after RFC.

maria: will do. I'll include sample queries for SREs to find redaction events.

deploy-bot: rollout started: feature/telemetry-sampling to staging at 2026-05-03T14:22:30Z

ton: thanks all. leaving this thread open — post updates here so we have single source. :+1:
